paper_title: SCpubr: a user-friendly R-package for generating publication-ready visualizations of single-cell transcriptome analyses

figures.label: Figure 1
figures.note: 9 panels: A diagram (hexagonal map of functions by topic); B/C scatter (UMAP embeddings, colored by cluster / MBP expression); D/I dot-plot (bubble: size=percent/count, color=expression/significance); E/H heatmap (enrichment / Jaccard correlation); F stacked horizontal bar (patient composition per cluster); G horizontal box plot (genes per patient)
figures.caption: Core features of SCpubr: function overview plus demonstration plots on six IDH1-mutant astrocytomas (UMAP, dot plots, heatmaps, bar plot, box plot).

tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Systematic comparison of scope, intended use, input structure, design philosophy, and availability of visualization types between SCpubr, Seurat, dittoSeq, scCustomize, and LotOfCells.
